notes.title: Blind upDate
notes.content:
Hello, Josh here, programmer and co-writer of Blind Date. It's been a while since I've done any work on the game, but I pushed a small update addressing a few long-standing bugs:


-No longer is it possible to cause the game to attempt to make a window size larger than the players monitor, now it will simply just switch to fullscreen in this case.

-Fixed some issues where names and certain events were not triggering properly in one of the dialog branches.


Unfortunately, that is all for now, but I actually hope to get some content going soon.


Good day!
